title: Multi-Vendor Marketplace
description: A platform like Amazon where third-party sellers can list products, manage inventory, and fulfill orders, while the platform handles payments and commissions.

modules.name: Vendor Portal
modules.description: Dashboard for sellers to add products, view analytics, and manage orders.

modules.name: Catalog Management
modules.description: Complex product taxonomy, variants, and inventory tracking.

modules.name: Split Payments
modules.description: Routing payments from buyers to vendors while deducting platform fees automatically.

modules.name: Review System
modules.description: Verified purchase reviews for both products and sellers.

learning_outcomes: Handling complex product variants and inventory
project_objectives: Support millions of SKUs with fast search

title: B2B Wholesale Portal
description: An e-commerce platform tailored for business-to-business transactions, featuring tiered pricing, bulk ordering, and credit terms.

modules.name: Tiered Pricing Engine
modules.description: Dynamic pricing based on customer groups and order volume.

modules.name: Quick Order Interface
modules.description: Allowing buyers to upload CSVs of SKUs for rapid bulk purchasing.

modules.name: Credit Management
modules.description: Handling net-30/net-60 payment terms and credit limits.

modules.name: Quote Generation
modules.description: System for buyers to request custom quotes and sales reps to approve them.

title: Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) Subscription Box
description: A subscription-based e-commerce site for a coffee brand. Users can subscribe to monthly deliveries, pause, or customize their boxes.

modules.name: Subscription Engine
modules.description: Managing recurring billing cycles and renewal states.

modules.name: Box Customization
modules.description: Interface for users to pick specific items for their upcoming delivery.

modules.name: Fulfillment Export
modules.description: Generating monthly pick-and-pack lists for the warehouse.

modules.name: Churn Prediction
modules.description: Basic analytics to identify users likely to cancel.

project_objectives: Reduce payment failures through automated retries

title: Flash Sale & Auction Platform
description: A high-traffic e-commerce platform that hosts time-limited sales and live bidding on exclusive products.

modules.name: Live Bidding Engine
modules.description: Real-time, WebSocket-based system to handle bids concurrently.

modules.name: Inventory Reservation
modules.description: Temporarily locking inventory when added to cart to prevent overselling.

modules.name: Countdown Timers
modules.description: Synchronized server-side timers for sale events.

modules.name: High-Traffic Queueing
modules.description: Waiting room system to manage spikes in traffic during product drops.

project_objectives: Handle 10,000 concurrent users during a drop
Ensure absolutely zero overselling of limited items

title: E-Commerce Recommendation Engine
description: A microservice that analyzes user browsing and purchase history to provide personalized product recommendations.

modules.name: Event Tracking API
modules.description: Ingesting clicks, views, and purchases from the main storefront.

modules.name: Collaborative Filtering
modules.description: Algorithm to recommend products based on similar users' behavior.

modules.name: Content-Based Filtering
modules.description: Recommending products based on tags, categories, and descriptions.

modules.name: A/B Testing Framework
modules.description: System to test different recommendation algorithms against each other.
